clause_text: The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon 7 days written notice.
notes: 7-day notice for convenience termination is extremely short and strips predictability

clause_text: Employee agrees not to work for any competitor, directly or indirectly, within India for a period of 2 years following termination.
notes: Post-termination non-compete void under Section 27, Indian Contract Act 1872

clause_text: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be finally resolved by binding arbitration. The parties waive any right to a jury trial or class action.
notes: Mandatory arbitration + class action waiver strips access to courts and collective redress

clause_text: Employee hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in any invention, work product or creative work, conceived or developed during employment, whether or not using Company resources.
notes: Overbroad IP assignment captures work done on personal time unrelated to job

clause_text: Any bonus or incentive payment shall be at the Company's sole and absolute discretion and shall not form part of contractual remuneration.
notes: Fully discretionary bonus means zero entitlement after work is performed

clause_text: We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
notes: Unilateral amendment without consent is unfair under EU Directive 93/13 and Indian Contract Act Section 10

clause_text: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless cancelled in writing at least 90 days prior to renewal.
notes: 90-day cancellation window is reasonable but should be tracked

clause_text: Employee shall indemnify and hold harmless the Company from any and all claims, damages, losses, costs and expenses (including legal fees) arising out of or in connection with Employee's services.
notes: Unlimited employee indemnity of employer without reciprocity is abusive

clause_text: In no event shall the Company be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. The Company's total liability shall not exceed USD 100.
notes: $100 liability cap is effectively zero — typical in SaaS ToS to shield providers

clause_text: This Agreement and all disputes shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, and subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Delaware.
notes: Foreign jurisdiction for Indian party makes dispute resolution prohibitively expensive

clause_text: If the Employee resigns within 24 months of joining, the Employee shall pay the Company Rs. 2,00,000 as liquidated damages for training costs.
notes: Training bond - company must prove actual loss under Section 74 ICA; in terrorem penalties are unenforceable

clause_text: Upon a change of control of either party, the other party may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect.
notes: Immediate termination on CoC can destroy M&A deal value overnight - must get waivers pre-closing

clause_text: The Company grants to the User a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use the Platform. The Company may revoke this license at any time without notice.
notes: Revocable license without notice means zero security of access - especially dangerous for SaaS business dependencies

clause_text: Employee agrees to keep the terms of this Agreement, including salary, bonus, and all workplace matters, strictly confidential in perpetuity.
notes: Perpetual confidentiality on salary terms can violate right to discuss pay; perpetual NDAs on misconduct are increasingly void

clause_text: The Company may assign this Agreement to any successor or affiliate without Employee's consent.
notes: Unilateral assignment means your contract can be transferred to any entity without your knowledge or consent

clause_text: By signing up for this Disney+ trial account, you agree that any dispute or claim arising out of or related to this agreement, or any past, present, or future dispute against the Company or any of its affiliates, theme parks, restaurants, or subsidiaries—including claims for bodily injury and wrongful death—shall be resolved solely through individual binding arbitration, and you irrevocably waive the right to a jury trial on behalf of yourself, your estate, heirs, and administrators.
notes: Disney+ Piccolo (2024) doctrine: using digital streaming ToS arbitration clause to bar wrongful death lawsuit at an affiliate restaurant venue

clause_text: Upon cessation of employment for any reason, the Employee shall not, for a period of 6 months following cessation, directly or indirectly provide services to or accept employment with named competitors including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, HCL, or Accenture to service any same client or customer serviced by the Employee during the preceding 12 months.
notes: Indian IT 6-month non-compete restraint: completely void under Section 27 Indian Contract Act 1872

clause_text: The Employee agrees to serve a mandatory minimum service bond period of 24 months. If the Employee departs prior to completion of 24 months, the Employee shall immediately pay Rupees 5,00,000 as liquidated damages for training cost recovery and onboarding expenses, and the Company reserves the right to withhold experience letters and final settlement.
notes: BYJU'S / EdTech service bond trap: penal liquidated damages without proof of actual loss violate Section 74 ICA

clause_text: The Company covenants to fully defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the special purpose entity (SPE) and its general partner from and against any and all debt obligations, synthetic lease liabilities, deficiency guarantees, and off-balance sheet credit facilities incurred in connection with project financing, without disclosing such indemnities in statutory financial statements.
notes: Enron off-balance sheet SPE indemnity trap: hiding corporate debt obligations and guaranteeing shell vehicles violates SOX and Companies Act Section 186

clause_text: Holders of Class B Common Stock shall be entitled to twenty (20) votes per share on all stockholder matters. In the event of any merger or change of control, the Founder shall receive an unallocated consulting fee of $185,000,000 and full founder buyout package, whereas Class A common stockholders shall receive consideration subject to senior liquidation preferences.
notes: WeWork founder super-voting shares (20:1) and change-of-control golden handcuffs: severe dilution and minority shareholder disenfranchisement

clause_text: The Purchaser shall hold an irrevocable call option and drag-along right to acquire an additional 15% voting equity, which together with its existing 15% holding shall confer the right to appoint a majority of the Board of Directors, triggering mandatory open offer requirements under Regulation 3 and Regulation 4 of SEBI SAST Regulations 2011 to acquire an additional 26% from public shareholders.
notes: SEBI SAST Takeover Regulations 2011: crossing 25% voting threshold or acquiring de facto control triggers mandatory tender offer for 26% public shares

clause_text: The Company shall enter into an exclusive commercial supply agreement with an entity in which the Managing Director's spouse holds a 40% controlling interest, without obtaining prior Audit Committee approval or shareholder resolution under Section 188 of the Companies Act 2013, rendering this contract voidable at the option of the Board.
notes: Companies Act 2013 Section 188 related party transaction trap: lack of audit committee and board approvals exposes directors to disqualification and renders contract voidable

clause_text: This acquisition agreement has an aggregate transaction value exceeding the Deal Value Threshold (DVT) of Rs. 2,000 Crore. Closing shall occur within 10 days of signing without conditioning closing upon prior merger clearance from the Competition Commission of India (CCI), exposing the parties to gun-jumping penalties under Section 43A of the Competition Act 2002.
notes: Competition Act 2002 DVT Rs 2000 Cr trap: closing transaction before CCI clearance violates Section 6 and triggers gun-jumping fines up to 1% of turnover

clause_text: The Service Provider shall act as a data processor and hereby agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the Data Fiduciary against any and all statutory penalties, fines up to Rs. 250 Crore, and regulatory enforcement actions imposed by the Data Protection Board of India under the DPDP Act 2023 arising from any personal data breach or unauthorized cross-border data transfer.
notes: DPDP Act 2023 statutory penalty transfer trap: attempting to shift non-delegable Data Fiduciary statutory fines onto data processor via back-to-back indemnity

clause_text: In the event the Executive departs or is terminated for cause, all vested phantom equity units, stock appreciation rights (SARs), and previously disbursed retention bonus payments shall be subject to immediate clawback and cash forfeiture, and the Executive covenants not to consult for any firm in the industry for 24 months.
notes: Phantom equity clawback & retention bonus forfeiture trap: post-termination clawbacks of earned remuneration create oppressive financial golden handcuffs

clause_text: The Employee agrees to a perpetual non-disparagement covenant and shall never at any time disparage, criticize, or make negative statements regarding the Company or its officers, and hereby waives any right to file workplace complaints or disclose allegations under the POSH Act 2013 (Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act).
notes: Perpetual non-disparagement gag clause attempting to stifle POSH Act reporting: void ab initio under Section 23 Indian Contract Act as contrary to public policy

clause_text: The Company reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service, user subscription tiers, and monthly recurring pricing at any time at its sole discretion without prior written notice, and Customer's continued access or use constitutes binding acceptance of all revised terms.
notes: Unilateral terms and price modification trap: violates Indian Consumer Protection Act 2019 Section 2(46) and EU Directive 93/13

clause_text: You agree that all disputes must be brought in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective, or representative proceeding, and the arbitrator shall have no authority to conduct class arbitration or consolidate claims of multiple consumers.
notes: Forced class action waiver: insulates corporations from mass consumer accountability for micro-overcharges

clause_text: Your subscription will automatically enroll in negative option billing and renew continuously every month at prevailing market rates. To cancel the zombie subscription, the user must submit a certified physical written notice via registered postal mail at least 45 days prior to the billing cycle; in-app or digital cancellation is unavailable.
notes: Negative option billing & dark pattern zombie subscription trap: intentional friction barriers violate CCPA Dark Pattern Guidelines 2023 and FTC rules

clause_text: The Company shall have an irrevocable, perpetual, sublicensable, royalty-free, worldwide license to aggregate, analyze, sell, and commercialize all personal data, telemetry, and confidential client documents with commercial advertising partners without restriction.
notes: Sweeping data commercialization license: breaches data minimization and purpose limitation under DPDP Act 2023 and GDPR

clause_text: The Seller shall remain bound by a perpetual, worldwide covenant not to compete, directly or indirectly, in any business segment currently or prospectively contemplated by the Buyer, and shall not invest in any competing technology venture anywhere in the world for 10 years.
notes: Overbroad M&A non-compete: reasonable goodwill non-competes are permitted under Section 27 Exception 1, but perpetual or worldwide bans are unreasonable and void

clause_text: The Buyer shall be entitled to indemnification without any deductible, basket, or liability cap, and Seller's aggregate liability for breaches of representations, environmental liabilities, and tax warranties shall be uncapped, surviving in perpetuity.
notes: Uncapped perpetual indemnity in M&A: absence of standard caps (typically 10-20% of enterprise value) leaves sellers exposed to infinite financial ruin

clause_text: All inventions, patent applications, copyrightable works, software code, algorithms, and business ideas developed by the Employee—including those developed on weekends, using personal computing hardware, outside working hours, and completely unrelated to the Company's business—shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company.
notes: Moonlighting IP grab: claiming weekend inventions built on personal devices violates employee rights and California Labor Code Sec 2870

clause_text: The Company reserves the right to terminate this agreement immediately for convenience without notice and without payment of any severance, while the Employee is bound to a mandatory 6-month notice period with no right of buy-out.
notes: Severe asymmetric termination rights: 0 days for employer vs 180 days locked in for employee creates gross contractual imbalance

clause_text: The Employer may at any time offset, deduct, or withhold from Employee's monthly wages any purported losses, customer churn, or administrative costs at the Employer's sole subjective assessment.
notes: Unauthorized wage deductions violate Section 7 of the Payment of Wages Act 1936
